suppress.notes: Reviewed 2026-06-24. CVE-2025-15104 relates to nu.validator:validator, which is not present in this repo's runtime classpath. Keep this suppression only for Dependency-Check false positives where validator libraries are mapped to the generic CPE "validator:validator". Runtime review found org.hibernate.validator:hibernate-validator:9.1.0.Final, but no nu.validator:validator dependency. Fluid Attacks still reports no patch available for the affected Nu Html Checker product.

Reviewed 2026-09-02. CVE-2025-21199 applies to Microsoft Azure Agent Installer products under the CPE family cpe:2.3:a:microsoft:azure_agent:* and the NVD affected-software entries are for the "backup" and "site_recovery" products. This repo contains the Java libraries com.microsoft.azure:applicationinsights-core and com.microsoft.azure:applicationinsights-web, which are being mapped to the generic azure_agent CPE by Dependency-Check. No newer com.microsoft.azure:applicationinsights-web release is currently available beyond 3.7.9. Keep this suppression only for that false-positive CPE match.

Reviewed 2026-07-23. CVE-2026-44891, CVE-2026-55831, and CVE-2026-55833 apply to Netty versions before 4.1.136.Final and 4.2.16.Final. The CVE descriptions and Netty release notes list 4.2.16.Final as the fixed 4.2.x release, and this repo already pins io.netty:netty-bom to 4.2.16.Final in build.gradle. Dependency-Check is still reporting these CVEs because the current NVD CPE configuration includes 4.2.16. Keep this suppression only for the already-fixed Netty 4.2.16.Final artifacts until NVD/Dependency-Check metadata catches up or a newer fixed 4.2.x release is available.

Reviewed 2026-08-10. These CVEs are currently reported against org.apache.qpid:proton-j:0.34.1, which is pulled transitively by org.apache.qpid:qpid-jms-client:2.10.0. Qpid JMS 2.10.0 and Proton-J 0.34.1 are the current Apache Qpid releases, so there is no newer drop-in dependency available at review time. This service uses Qpid JMS as a client for controlled Azure Service Bus messaging, not as a public AMQP listener. Keep this suppression narrowly scoped to proton-j 0.34.1 and revisit once Apache publishes clearer CVE/fixed-version guidance or a newer Qpid JMS/Proton-J release is available.
